title: Segment growth masking margin erosion
question: Group operating profit grew. Which segment drove the growth, and is there anything in the segment results that management should be concerned about?

gold_answer.summary: Group operating profit rose GBP 164k (+14.6%) to GBP 1,284k. Software drove all of it: its operating profit rose GBP 260k (+50.0%) on 30.0% revenue growth, with margin improving from 26.0% to 30.0%. Hardware is the concern: its operating profit fell GBP 96k (-16.0%) even though its revenue grew 5.0%, as margin dropped from 10.0% to 8.0%. The group total hides this.
gold_answer.main_driver: Software drove more than 100% of group profit growth; hardware profit fell despite higher revenue.

design_note: Baseline. Tests whether the model looks beneath a healthy group total. A response that only describes the group-level growth, or does not flag hardware margin erosion, fails C4.
